column3: “Answered and said” is rendered “answered.”
“A man of lips” is rendered “a talkative man.”
“Empty boasts” is rendered “boasts.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Who will give” is rendered “would that.”
“Double belongs to sound wisdom” is rendered “sound wisdom has two sides”; the meaning is uncertain. “Will cause to forget to you” is rendered “forgets.”
“The searching of God” is rendered “the depths of God,” and “the end” as “the limits.”
“The heights of the heavens” is rendered “They are high as the heavens.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“And he may shut up so he may summon an assembly” is rendered “or shuts up, Or calls an assembly.”
“And not he shows himself attentive” is rendered “without investigating”; it may also mean “will He not consider it?”
“A hollow person” is rendered “an idiot,” and “a male donkey of a wild donkey” as “the foal of a wild donkey.” The meaning is uncertain.
NASB supplies “right.” “Palms” is rendered “hand.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“From blemish” is rendered “without moral defect.”
The Hebrew reads “you trouble”; NASB reads “your trouble.”
“Lifespan” is rendered “life,” and “it will be dark” as “Darkness.”
“Well protected” is rendered “look around”; the meaning of the verb is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew.
“A gasp of life” is rendered “to breathe their last.”
